clause: Effect command surface + STUDIO_EFFECT_* events + gated lifecycle [STU-FX-007,STU-FX-008,STU-FX-009,STU-FX-011a]

scope.summary: Implement the model-steerable typed effect commands STUDIO_EFFECT_APPLY / _UPDATE / _REORDER / _TOGGLE / _REMOVE / _MASK_EDIT / _BAKE on event_family=studio.effect, each routed sandbox -> StudioValidationDescriptor -> PromotionGate (never a direct authority write). Blend-options fold into the standard StudioBlendMode+opacity surface (no separate fade command). Repeat-last-effect + repeat-with-new-settings as ONE deduped command. Effect on placed_asset/smart-object applies to the rendered proxy; convert-for-filters collapses to a no-op (layers are filter-hosting by default).
acceptance_criteria: 7 STUDIO_EFFECT_* commands+events gated through promotion; deduped fade into blend; single repeat-last; smart-object proxy apply
proof_targets: command-contract + fail-closed direct-write negative + event-registration test
expected_tests: live: model effect mutation blocked from direct authority write (sandbox->validation->promotion)
test: 7 STUDIO_EFFECT_* variants registered + wire strings; repeat-last is one command; placed-asset proxy application

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No model-steerable effect API; effect mutations bypass validation/promotion.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
